desc: You’ll find yourself adventure-ready with the CZ 600 Trail. This light compact rifle is packed with a full set of features that make a difference to today’s marksman. The Trail features AR magazine compatibility in 223 Rem and uses CZ Bren 2 magazines in 7.62×39. In addition to a common magazine, the Trail delivers ambidextrous mag release and safety levers that will feel familiar to those used to the AR platform. The PDW-style stock is quick to deploy and allows the Trail to collapse to a very compact OAL when space is at a premium.
